summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the selected mixed Greek–Latin working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the conditions, necessity, negations, innocence language, wealth reduction, and stated life consequence. Their notes distinguish editorial readings and restorations from preserved wording, disclose the Greek–Latin boundary, and retain the unresolved Latin crux without adopting the apparatus proposal. The corrected apparatus disclosure agrees with the supplied attributed recheck report. Acceptance concerns these supplied drafts and their disclosure of the supplied evidence; it does not authenticate unseen images or manuscripts, resolve the crux, or certify exhaustive collation.
